Messages.Author: Morgan Vening
Messages.Body:
A newbie brought it to my attention the possibility that a Bum's Rush
that is blocked, ends the action, and hence the 'Do not replace until
end of action' may expire and a replacement can be drawn before combat
begins.

This isn't how we've played it, in times past, but that doesn't
necessarily mean that it's been played correctly. I checked the FAQ
and the rules, and neither seems particularly clear.

Morgan Vening

Messages.Author: Peter D Bakija
Messages.Body:
Morgan Vening wrote:

> A newbie brought it to my attention the possibility that a Bum's Rush
> that is blocked, ends the action, and hence the 'Do not replace until
> end of action' may expire and a replacement can be drawn before combat
> begins.

Actions don't end until any resulting combat is resolved--combat from
blocking is part of a given action sequence. When the fight is over, then
the action is over.

I'm not entierly sure what happens if someone Bum's Rushes someone, they
block, there is a fight, and at the end of the fight someone plays Psyche!,
but that is another question all together.

Messages.Author: Halcyan 2
Messages.Body:
>> A newbie brought it to my attention the possibility that a Bum's Rush
>> that is blocked, ends the action, and hence the 'Do not replace until
>> end of action' may expire and a replacement can be drawn before combat
>> begins.
>
>Actions don't end until any resulting combat is resolved--combat from
>blocking is part of a given action sequence. When the fight is over, then
>the action is over.
>

If a Bum's Rush is blocked, you don't draw a replacement card because the
action is not yet over. It is very well possible that even though the action is
blocked, it might continue via Form of Mist, Shadow Body, Toreador's Bane, or
Flow Within the Mountain.

Halcyan 2

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Peter D Bakija wrote:
> I'm not entierly sure what happens if someone Bum's Rushes someone, they
> block, there is a fight, and at the end of the fight someone plays Psyche!,
> but that is another question all together.

All combats are part of some action. There are no action-free combats.
The Psyche! combat is part of the Bum's Rush action in your example.

Messages.Author: Peter D Bakija
Messages.Body:
Kulaid wrote:

> HAHA.. I know there are combat outside of an action...
>
> Fast Reaction combat!!!!
> Siren's Lure, Slave combat... They happen outside of an action...

Well, not really. Fast Reaction combat is still part of the original action
that was blocked. Slave combat is part of the action that got blocked, and
the Slave tagged into. I'm not sure what Siren's Lure does, but I suspect
that it is a similar deal.
